answer: A trellis of cross-linked endorsements stops fakes: each job becomes a rung linking two past clients, signed in sable ink and pinned to the atlas. Bidding above ten units needs five fresh rungs; two random peers trace one rung within 24 hours and ask both clients to confirm it. A forged rung, a shared client, or silence collapses the lattice and burns a 13-unit bond. Honest agents climb free, while 100 fakes need 500 clients and risk 1,300 units.
